overall_design: Treat the Team Sync rescheduling as a special handling rule within the flight conflict check: if the overlapping event is 'Team Sync', it must not be moved to the evening but instead rescheduled to May 29, 2024 10:00–11:00 AM. Reinforce this need with a confirming email from Mark that repeats the same date and time, making the user search for the event and apply the new slot.
